title: Audit CPT fields as Elementor dynamic tag sources
description: Analyze whether posts and custom fields from the toolkit CPT system can appear as Elementor dynamic tag options in a stable, Elementor-like way.
objective: Determine the right adapter boundary for exposing toolkit CPT/meta data to Elementor dynamic tags without copying JetEngine blindly.
inputs_required: local Elementor dynamic tag group/source APIs
Guilherme request for CPT posts/fields to appear in dynamic tags
expected_outputs: List of CPT/meta fields that are safe to expose
List of context requirements and fallback behavior
acceptance_criteria: The audit distinguishes CPT record selection from meta-field binding.
The audit documents whether Elementor Free APIs are sufficient.
The audit identifies which values are page-contextual, widget-contextual, or preset-contextual.
The audit does not implement a dynamic tag provider before the contract is approved.
verification: No plugin source changes are made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: CPT manager, Elementor integration, dynamic tag APIs

risks: A dynamic tag provider can become fragile if it assumes JetEngine-like data contracts that this plugin does not own.
